The only OLE DB Commands on [CRM] are Update NeedToSendMailBit (Gen_powerofattorneyBase) and Update sentToPrintOn (Gen_powerofattorney). Kingsway is referenced only at DTSX:23. The log provider is at DTSX:65. All four agent-email components have Input0_ProcessInput commented out ('In Comment due to 13366', DTSX:13989, 15683, 23130, 24705). wrongUnits.problem: The text says the CSV mailing file and the exceptions file are built 'from all letter-table rows not yet processed'. That is not true. A row is dropped silently, without being written to either file and without being marked processed, when any of these is not found: an agent, then an agency; the POA (Get Power Of Attorney); the contact (Get Contact); a pension program, then a provident account. Such rows stay isProcessed = 0.
wrongUnits.correct: Only unprocessed rows (isProcessed = 0) that the CRM lookups can enrich reach the files. Rows without an agent/agency, POA, contact, or pension/provident match stop in the flow and remain unprocessed. Rows that reach the files are split by agent/agency email: rows with an email go to the mailing file, rows without one go to the exceptions file.
wrongUnits.evidence: DTSX:31557, 31636, 31715, 31861, 32089, 33900; Send Poa Emails path list (no path from those No Match outputs)

results.detail: The order, triggers and line numbers match the 18 precedence constraints at DTSX:44824-44841. All are Success (no DTS:Value) and LogicalAnd. All 19 executables appear and none is disabled. The Set Destinations Paths label matches ScriptMain.cs: it builds the base name + '_' + yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm + '.csv' and the {Year}/{Month} path, and creates the folders (DTSX:36911-36925). Send Email uses the file name without its extension as subject.

Each listed item is ETL plumbing or has no business effect. Set Queue Id Variable sets AgentDescQueueId, which is used only inside the commented-out email code (DTSX:14059, 15755, 23205, 24777). Get Base Fields Values sets User::UserId/OrganizationId, which nothing reads (DTSX:11290-11291 only). The three Set Task Name Variable components are synchronous pass-through scripts that only set ComponentTaskName. Counters, ETL warnings and error decoration are plumbing. Kingsway is unused, and SRS.SSIS_Logs is the log provider. No business component is in the list.

wrongUnits.problem: 'לייפוי כוח חדש מנספח 2/3/5 נשמרים נתוני מכתב (JSON)' reads as if it applies to every activated POA with appendix 2/3/5. In fact AppendixType is reached only through Is Renewal 'Not Renewal'. That means a Lookup match on an active POA of the same account/program whose agent or agency id differs. wrongUnits.problem: The text says every due POA is active and 'letters to the agent are ready for sending'. Activation failures go to an unconnected error output, so activation is not guaranteed. JSON letter data is written only in the other-agent + appendix 2/3/5 branch, and only into an existing unprocessed staging row. 0031 never reads the JSON, and the agent e-mail code is commented out, so 'ready for sending' is not shown by the files. This conflicts with the package's own summary ('החבילה הזו לא קוראת אותם') and with finding#3.
wrongUnits.correct: Due waiting POAs are set to active unless the SDK update fails; failures are not logged. Where an active POA of another agent existed, its gen_receivingdateofcancelpoa was set (new receiving date +3h if its appendix is 2/3/5, otherwise NULL). If the new POA's appendix is 2/3/5 and an unprocessed staging row without JSON exists, letter JSON was stored there. Its use for sending is not shown in the supplied files.

wrongUnits.problem: The text says the JSON is saved 'in the POA's row' of the staging letters table. The code emits one Custom Output row per POA, but sets emailDetailsJson only for the IsFirst POA of each POA Main. The other rows have NULL JSON and go to the unconnected 'No Data' output. So for a POA Main with several due POAs, only the first processed POA's staging row gets the JSON; the others get nothing.

The condition is: row exists, isProcessed = 0 and emailDetailsJson is null. Staging rows of the other POAs under the same POA Main are not updated.

results.detail: All eight conditions are quoted exactly and their outcomes match the paths. For Is Renewal, AppendixType and Check Format, the default outputs are Not Renewal, AppendixTypeNeedToSendMail and EmailFormat 2. The CASE has no ELSE, so the result is NULL otherwise. The Update Json WHERE and the ACTIVE condition (main.cs:34) match.

All three writes, their mechanisms and their conditions match. The SDK update gen_currentstate = 1 is reached from all three branches. The SQL update on Gen_powerofattorneyBase targets the old active POA (Param_1 = PowerOfAttorneyIdPa). The staging emailDetailsJson update follows Not Renewal plus appendix 2/3/5.

Unit 1: Handle Active Status cancels only where Gen_enddate <= GETDATE() and Gen_currentstate = 1 (DTSX:18171). The only supplied flow that cancels an active POA when a waiting POA of another agent exists is 0029 'Package\Cancel Active POA' (0029:3851-3890), and it is DTS:Disabled=True (0029:2555). 'Unknown' is therefore legitimate for active code. Unit 2: the Lookup is full cache with first match (DTSX:27079, CacheType 0). Unit 3: ACTIVE = 1 (DTSX:30447), //ACTIVE (DTSX:1936), 0029:3889 '-- waiting', and DTSX:3326 '--appendix b1' on Gen_powerofattorneymain.Gen_appendixtype are all exact.

EmailFormatTrue goes to With Commission Appointment (format 3, error text DTSX:17130), and the default goes to To Perform Actions (format 8). RecievingDate = genreceivingdateofcancelpoa (main.cs:99). In 0031 that field is set by Handle Wait Status when a POA of another agent was activated on the same account or program and the old POA's appendix was 2, 3 or 5.
